from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
img=Image.new('CMYK',(64,64),(0,0,0,0))
img.save('/workspace/hugecmyk.jpg',format='JPEG',quality=100,subsampling=0)
b=bytearray(Path('/workspace/hugecmyk.jpg').read_bytes())
sof=b.find(b'\xff\xc0')
print('sof',sof, list(b[sof:sof+20]))
# set one component to h=1,v=4 and the rest to 4,1 maybe to force unusual ratios
for i,v in enumerate([0x14,0x41,0x41,0x41]):
    b[sof+10+i*3]=v
Path('/workspace/hugecmyk.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('patched', list(b[sof:sof+20]))
PY
